required_before_completion: Obtain the selected development archive that the source, binary and deployment verifiers bind.
Recapture stable-native with the installed sts1.1.3 and candidate-native with a second explicitly supported STS identity.
Re-execute the native platform profile in a KVM guest with the selected glibc 2.44 runtime and confirm the transferred consumer sources before rebuild.
Regenerate docs/evidence/M12-002/verification.json with tools/m12_002_deployment.py collect --binary-report <verified report> after the final source edits.
Rerun scripts/check-task M12-002 --json and only then claim COMPLETE.
